# llms.txt — @fams/demo-kit export index (hand-authored — see
# packages/skeleton-kit/llms.txt's header for why; same rationale applies).
# Every current barrel export symbol name (across all three entry points —
# `.`, `./react`, `./console`) must appear somewhere below as a whole word;
# `pnpm build:llms -- --check` (wired into `pnpm lint`) enforces it.
# format: Symbol(s) :: purpose :: key signature/props :: file

RelationalStore, computeSchemaFingerprint :: The core in-browser store — entities + bidirectional referential integrity, typed CRUD + `Query`/`WhereClause` filtering, snapshot/restore. React-free. `computeSchemaFingerprint` hashes a schema so a persisted snapshot can be version-stamped and invalidated when the schema changes underneath it (stale-tab guard). :: new RelationalStore(schema: Record<string, EntitySchema>); computeSchemaFingerprint(schema) → string :: src/store.ts
FieldType, FieldDef, Cardinality, RefDef, EntitySchema, EntityRecord, StoreSnapshot, WhereClause, Query, QueryResult, Referrer :: The store's type vocabulary — schema shape, field/ref definitions, and the query contract `RelationalStore` implements. :: EntitySchema { fields: FieldDef[], refs?: RefDef[] } :: src/types.ts
MemoryPersistence, SessionStoragePersistence, Persistence, SessionStorageOptions, PersistedState :: Injectable session persistence for the store — an in-memory implementation and a `sessionStorage`-backed one (per-viewer isolated state, decision #19). `PersistedState` wraps the saved snapshot with its schema fingerprint. :: Persistence { load(): T | null; save(value: T): void } :: src/persistence.ts
loadSeeds, validateSeedRefs, seedRecords, DanglingSeedRefError, SeedSet, PersonaDef, RoleMap, DanglingRef :: Seed loader — loads per-module seed JSON into the store; LOUD on dangling refs (`DanglingSeedRefError`, never a silent skip). :: loadSeeds(store, seeds: SeedSet) — throws DanglingSeedRefError on any unresolved ref :: src/seeds.ts
createPersonaAuth, PersonaAuth, Persona :: A React-free persona auth shim — personas ARE seed data (users.json + roles, decision #18), zero new auth machinery. :: createPersonaAuth(personas: Persona[]) → PersonaAuth { current(), login(), logout(), subscribe(), privileges(), userType() } :: src/persona.ts
buildHandlers, setupDemoWorker, HttpMethod, BuildHandlersOptions, EndpointContract, EndpointOp, ListOp, GetOp, CreateOp, UpdateOp, RemoveOp, CustomOp :: MSW mock-API generator — turns an `EndpointContract` (list/get/create/update/remove/custom ops) into real MSW handlers backed by the `RelationalStore`, matching the production API contract. :: buildHandlers(store, contracts: EndpointContract[]) :: src/handlers.ts
usePersona :: The only React import in the package — subscribes a component to a `PersonaAuth`'s live persona (re-renders on login/logout). Exported ONLY from `@fams/demo-kit/react` so the core entry stays React-free. :: usePersona(auth: PersonaAuth) → { persona, privileges, userType } :: src/react.ts
DemoConsole, DemoConsoleProps, DemoConsoleOption, DemoConsolePersona :: The hover-reveal demo control surface (decision #18): tenant/persona switch, module jump, seed reset, share-link — wired by the app via callbacks. Exported from `@fams/demo-kit/console` only (React dependency isolated to this subpath). :: DemoConsoleProps { tenants, personas, onTenantChange, onPersonaChange, onModuleJump, onSeedReset, onShareLink, … } :: src/console/DemoConsole.tsx
useHoverReveal, HoverReveal :: The hover-top-edge-to-reveal interaction hook backing `DemoConsole`'s fade-in behavior. :: useHoverReveal() → HoverReveal { visible, … } :: src/console/useHoverReveal.ts
